title: Improved Regularity for Nonlocal Hamilton--Jacobi Equations with Superlinear Hamiltonians
summary: We investigate the regularity of viscosity solutions to a class of nonlocal Hamilton-Jacobi equations driven by x-dependent integro-differential operators and coercive superlinear Hamiltonians. We first establish H{ö}lder regularity for bounded viscosity solutions under general structural and continuity assumptions on the underlying L{é}vy measures, without imposing any ellipticity condition on the nonlocal operator.
